scenarios.name: Dismiss Show Panels from the expanded Constrain command menu

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open with an active editable `Sketch1` in the MCAD Software
the full Sketch ribbon is visible
the Constrain additional command area is open
the user right-clicks Edit Coordinate System
Sketch, Create, Modify, Pattern, Constrain, Insert and Format are checked
the Show Panels submenu closes and the command context menu remains open
the Constrain additional command area remains open
the command context menu and Constrain additional command area close
the editable sketch remains active and unchanged
